name: Guangdong Shenling Environmental Systems Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Shenling Environmental Systems Co., Ltd. research, develops, designs, manufactures, and markets air conditioning equipment in China and internationally. It offers industrial and special, as well as public and commercial air conditioning units for industrial and research process, public and commercial buildings, and other applications. In addition, the company offers data service products, such as cloud data and computing centers, communication infrastructure, computer technology services, precision electronic instrument manufacturing, and other fields.
